correctness.rationale: At a=2, X⁴+Y⁴+Z⁴+2X²Y²=(X²+Y²+iZ²)(X²+Y²−iZ²). The two smooth conics meet in exactly two A3 tacnodes. Near either, u=1+Y², v=Z yields u²+v⁴+t⁴(u−1)=0; U=u+t⁴/2 makes U²+v⁴=t⁴(1+t⁴/4). After unit reparametrization the weight-(2,1,1) blowup yields an exceptional smooth genus-one w²+V⁴=1; the v-chart relation r=vR and w²+1−R⁴=0 shows transverse attachment to each conic. Four nodes on K2,2 with two elliptic components give genus 3; contracting both rational valence-two conics yields E1,E2 joined at two nodes. Their infinity attachment points P± are distinct fixed points of V↦−V, an involution preserving origin P+ with four fixed points, hence inversion and T=P−−P+ is nonzero E[2]. The generalized-Jacobian gluing sequence has class (T1,−T2) of exact order two, nonsplit and split by [2]. Binary quartic I≠0,J=0 gives j=1728. Complex field, a−2=t⁴, identity component only.
